title: PCR Preparation from Deep Well Plates to 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load plates and tip racks
steps.instruction: Place the four 96‑well deep‑well plates in deck slots 4, 1, 5, and 2 (Plate 1 → slot 4, Plate 2 → slot 1, Plate 3 → slot 5, Plate 4 → slot 2). Load the P20 multi‑channel tip racks in slots 10, 7, 11, and 8 in the same order. Mount the P20 multi‑channel pipette on the specified mount (left or right) as defined in the protocol parameters.

steps.title: Load control wells
steps.instruction: Ensure that the negative and positive control samples are already pre‑loaded into wells O24 and P24 of the 384‑well PCR plate. Verify that wells G12 and H12 of Plate 4 (the deep‑well plate in slot 2) remain empty.

steps.title: Transfer samples to 384 plate
steps.instruction: For each sample (1–382), pick up a fresh tip, aspirate 5 µL from the appropriate source well in the deep‑well plate, and dispense into the designated well of the 384‑well plate according to the following mapping: Plate 1 (slot 4) → wells A1‑A23, Plate 2 (slot 1) → wells B1‑B23, Plate 3 (slot 5) → wells A2‑A24, Plate 4 (slot 2) → wells B2‑B24. Complete all transfers from one plate before moving to the next. After dispensing, drop the tip. Repeat until the specified number of samples have been transferred.
